transcript.en: We've got to choose a topic for our experiment, haven't we, Jack?
transcript.zh: 我们得为我们的实验做一个选题，是吗，杰克？

transcript.en: Were you thinking of something to do with seeds?
transcript.zh: 你想过种子的有关事情吗？

transcript.en: That's right. I thought we could look at seed germination
transcript.zh: 是的，我想我们也许做一下关于种子发芽的事情，

transcript.en: how a seed begins to grow.
transcript.zh: 看一下种子是如何生长的。

transcript.en: OK. Any particular reason?
transcript.zh: 好的，还有什么其它特别的原因吗？

transcript.en: I know you're hoping to work in plant science eventually...
transcript.zh: 我知道你最终想从事植物科学方面的工作。

transcript.en: Yeah, but practically everything we do is going to feed into that.
transcript.zh: 是的，但是实际上现在我们做的每一件事都是为了这个目的。

transcript.en: No. there's an optional module on seed structure and function in the third year that I might do,
transcript.zh: 是的，在三年级有个种子结构和功能的可选模块，我可能会选这一选题，

transcript.en: so I thought it might be useful for that.
transcript.zh: 所以我认为它可能会比较有用。

transcript.en: If I choose that option.
transcript.zh: 如果我做了那一选择，

transcript.en: I don't have to do a dissertation module.
transcript.zh: 我就不用再做论文模块了。

transcript.en: Good idea.
transcript.zh: 好主意。

transcript.en: Well, I thought for this experiment we could look at the relationship between seed size and the way the seeds are planted.
transcript.zh: 好的，我想在这个实验当中我们可以探讨一下种子大小和种子播种方式之间的关系。

transcript.en: So, we could plant different sized seeds in different ways,
transcript.zh: 这样子，我们就可以以不同的方式种植不同大小的种子，

transcript.en: and see which grow best.
transcript.zh: 看看哪一种生长得最好。

transcript.en: OK. We'd need to allow time for the seeds to come up.
transcript.zh: 好的，那我们需要匀出时间来让种子发芽。

transcript.en: That should be fine if we start now.
transcript.zh: 如果我们现在开始的话会好一些，

transcript.en: A lot of the other possible experiments need quite a bit longer.
transcript.zh: 因为其它一些实验需要更长的时间。

transcript.en: So that'd make it a good one to choose.
transcript.zh: 所以这是一个很好的选择。

transcript.en: And I don’t suppose it'd need much equipment;
transcript.zh: 而且也不需要很多设备。

transcript.en: we're not doing chemical analysis or anything.
transcript.zh: 我们不需要做化学分析或其它的一些事情，

transcript.en: Though that's not really an issue,
transcript.zh: 虽然这不是问题关键所在，

transcript.en: we've got plenty of equipment in the laboratory.
transcript.zh: 我们实验室里有很多设备。

transcript.en: Yeah. We need to have a word with the tutor if we're going to go ahead with it though.
transcript.zh: 好的，但是如果我们要做这一选题的研究，我们需要和导师谈一谈。

transcript.en: I'm sure our aim's OK.
transcript.zh: 我相信我们的选题方向是正确的。

transcript.en: It's not very ambitious but the assignment's only ten percent of our final mark, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 选题并不宏大，好实现，而且这次任务只占期末分数的10%,是吧。

transcript.en: But we need to be sure we're the only ones doing it.
transcript.zh: 但是我们得确定我们是唯一做着选题的小组。

transcript.en: Yeah, it's only five percent actually,
transcript.zh: 哦，实际上只占5%，

transcript.en: but it'd be a bit boring if everyone was doing it.
transcript.zh: 但是如果每一个人都选这一选题就会比较无聊。

transcript.en: Did you read that book on seed germination on our reading list?
transcript.zh: 你读过我们阅读清单上关于种子发芽的那本书了吗？

transcript.en: The one by Graves?
transcript.zh: 是那本由格雷夫斯写的吗？

transcript.en: I looked through it for my last experiment,
transcript.zh: 我在上次的实验中翻阅过它，

transcript.en: though it wasn't all that relevant there.
transcript.zh: 尽管它并不是那么相关。

transcript.en: It would be for this experiment, though.
transcript.zh: 虽然这本书是用于此次实验的，

transcript.en: I found it quite hard to follow -lots about the theory,
transcript.zh: 但是有很多难理解的理论，

transcript.en: which I hadn't expected.
transcript.zh: 这都是我之前没有意识到的。

transcript.en: Yes, I'd been hoping for something more practical.
transcript.zh: 是的，我一直希望有更加实际的东西。

transcript.en: It does include references to the recent findings on genetically-modified seeds, though.
transcript.zh: 虽然它确实提到了最近关于转基因种子的发现。

transcript.en: Yes, that was interesting.
transcript.zh: 嗯，这很有意思。

transcript.en: I read an article about seed germination by Lee Hall.
transcript.zh: 我读过一篇李霍尔写的关于种子发芽的文章。

transcript.en: About seeds that lie in the ground for ages and only germinate after a fire?
transcript.zh: 内容是关于种子埋藏在地下很长时间然后只在一场大火之后才发芽？

transcript.en: That's the one.
transcript.zh: 哦，原来是这篇，

transcript.en: I knew a bit about it already, but not about this research.
transcript.zh: 我之前就有所耳闻了，但不是关于这个研究的。

transcript.en: His analysis of figures comparing the times of the fires and the proportion of seeds that germinated was done in a lot of detail - very impressive.
transcript.zh: 他对大火发生的次数和种子发芽的比例进行了分析，其描述之细致，令人印象深刻。

transcript.en: Was that the article with the illustrations of early stages of plant development?
transcript.zh: 是一篇说明植物早期发展的文章吗？

transcript.en: They were very clear.
transcript.zh: 条理非常清晰。

transcript.en: I think those diagrams were in another article.
transcript.zh: 我想那些图是在另外一篇文章里的。

transcript.en: Anyway, shall we have a look at the procedure for our experiment?
transcript.zh: 不管怎样，我们先看看我们的实验步骤，好吧？

transcript.en: We'll need to get going with it quite soon.
transcript.zh: 我们很快就得开始了。

transcript.en: Right. So the first thing we have to do is find our seeds.
transcript.zh: 好的，所以我们需要做的第一件事就是找到我们的种子。

transcript.en: I think vegetable seeds would be best.
transcript.zh: 我认为蔬菜种子是最好的，

transcript.en: And obviously they mustn't all be the same size.
transcript.zh: 很明显它们不是一样大小的。

transcript.en: So, how many sorts do we need?
transcript.zh: 好的，那我们需要几种呢？

transcript.en: About four different ones?
transcript.zh: 四种不同种类的吗？

transcript.en: I think that would be enough.
transcript.zh: 我想那就够了，

transcript.en: There'll be quite a large number of seeds for each one.
transcript.zh: 每类种子都需要相当多的数量。

transcript.en: Then, for each seed we need to find out how much it weighs,
transcript.zh: 然后，对于每一类种子我们需要测量其重量

transcript.en: and also measure its dimensions,
transcript.zh: 并且测量其尺寸，

transcript.en: and we need to keep a careful record of all that.
transcript.zh: 然后详细记录下这些数字。

transcript.en: That'll be quite time-consuming.
transcript.zh: 这会很耗时。

transcript.en: And we also need to decide how deep we're going to plant the seeds
transcript.zh: 我们还得决定挖多深的坑，

transcript.en: right on the surface, a few millimetres down, or several centimetres.
transcript.zh: 就几毫米深还是几厘米深。

transcript.en: OK. So then we get planting.
transcript.zh: 好的，然后我们才开始种植。

transcript.en: Do you think we can plant several seeds together in the same plant pot?
transcript.zh: 你认为我们可以在同一个花盆里种几类不同的种子吗？

transcript.en: No, I think we need a different one for each seed.
transcript.zh: 不行，我认为一个花盆应该种一类种子。

transcript.en: Right. And we'll need to label them - we can use different coloured labels.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们还得给它们贴上标签，我们可以用不同颜色的标签。

transcript.en: Then we wait for the seeds to germinate - I reckon that'll be about three weeks, depending on what the weather's like.
transcript.zh: 然后我们就等待种子发芽，我想这大概需要三个星期，这取决于天气状况。

transcript.en: Then we see if our plants have come up, and write down how tall they've grown.
transcript.zh: 然后就可以观察我们的植物是否都长出来了，然后记录下它们生长的高度。

transcript.en: Then all we have to do is look at our numbers, and see if there's any relation between them.
transcript.zh: 接着就是对比数字，看看它们之间是否有联系。

transcript.en: That's right. So ...
transcript.zh: 好的，然后...
